telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Health care practitioners practicing telehealth must be licensed in good standing in all states where licensed; the standard of care requires an established patient to visit an in-person practitioner within 12 months of initial telemedicine service; Schedule II controlled substances may not be prescribed via telehealth except for established patients with a physician; abortifacients and gender altering medication to minors prohibited via telehealth.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: a prohibition of prescribing any controlled substance listed in Schedule II of the Uniform Controlled Substance Act, unless authorized by another section: Provided, That the prescribing limitations contained in this section do not apply to a physician or a member of the same group practice with an established patient

At all times during such cooperation, the medical or dental care of the patient is directed by the physician, dentist, or podiatrist.
